The '''Telerath 2nd''' was a [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]]-sized military unit in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. It was part of the [[Ralltiir Corps]], where it was larger than the unit [[Graayson's Company]], and shared its name with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]].<ref name="KOTOR guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Telerath 2nd was mentioned in the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2008]] supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', in "Chapter XI: The Republic,"<ref name="KOTOR guide" /> a chapter that was written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="Miller Campaign">{{Faraway|url=games/swkotorguide.html|text=Star Wars Roleplaying Game: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide}}</ref>
